title: 合并还没获批：他已断言史上最大，马斯克想做的事藏不住了
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: See, let's start with Tesla and not so much with the numbers, but what was said yesterday when we got those SpaceX earnings and about this idea that a committee had been formed
segments.zh: 我们先从特斯拉说起，不重点看数字，而是看昨天SpaceX财报发布时提到的成立委员会一事

segments.en: to maybe combine these two companies, something that has been speculated for quite a bit.
segments.zh: 可能将这两家公司合并，这一猜测已流传一段时间

segments.en: And I guess when we saw that quote-unquote flying car the other day, that raised the speculation even more.
segments.zh: 前几天看到所谓的飞行汽车，更加剧了这种猜测

segments.en: Does that make sense to you? Just match these two companies up?
segments.zh: 你觉得这合理吗？把这两家公司合并？

segments.en: Well, look, I think it's going to happen. I think Elon's been talking about it for some time, Tesla just posted solid numbers.
segments.zh: 我认为这会发生。马斯克已经谈论一段时间了，特斯拉刚公布了稳健的业绩

segments.en: And look, all signs point to Musk wanting to consolidate the companies.
segments.zh: 所有迹象都表明马斯克想要整合这些公司

segments.en: SpaceX, as you saw, the share price, up 10% that makes it easier to buy stuff.
segments.zh: 如你所见，SpaceX股价上涨10%，这让收购更容易

segments.en: This would be the biggest merger in history. I think Musk really wants to combine SpaceX's AI compute strengths with Tesla's cars,
segments.zh: 这将是史上最大合并。我认为马斯克真的想将SpaceX的AI计算优势与特斯拉的汽车、

segments.en: energy and robotics. That's a powerful combination.
segments.zh: 能源和机器人业务结合。这是一个强大的组合

segments.en: Recent developments make it easier just for an SEC approval for auto voting for the board.
segments.zh: 近期进展使SEC批准自动投票给董事会更容易

segments.en: And the big question is, what are the regulators going to say about this?
segments.zh: 关键问题是，监管机构会对此作何表态？

segments.en: And what will SpaceX have to do to make it happen?
segments.zh: SpaceX需要采取哪些行动才能实现？

segments.en: And the big question is I think there'll be valuations SEC because they keep Tesla China a lot to sort out here, but as a bidding person, you'd have to say this would be the biggest
segments.zh: 我认为关键问题在于估值和SEC，因为特斯拉中国有很多问题需要解决，但作为竞购方，你不得不说这将是史上最大的

segments.en: merger in history. And I think Elon wants to do it.
segments.zh: 合并交易。而且我认为埃隆想这么做。

segments.en: Well, it'll be interesting to see too. And it was interesting also to see in SpaceX just how far along the AI business has come.
segments.zh: 嗯，这也将很有意思。而且看到SpaceX的人工智能业务已经发展到了如此程度，也很有趣。
